021import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
022import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
023
024import java.util.Comparator;
025
026/**
027 * ShopPrice
028 *
029 * @author creatorfromhell
030 * @since 6.3.0.0
031 */
032public interface ShopPrice<U> {
033
034  /**
035   * Retrieves the price of the shop.
036   *
037   * @return the price of the shop as an instance of type U, where U represents a generic type.
038   */
039  U price();
040
041  /**
042   * Sets the price for a shop.
043   *
044   * @param price the price to set for the shop; must be of type U and should not be null
045   */
046  void price(U price);
047
048  /**
049   * Formats a string representation based on the provided world and optional currency.
050   *
051   * @param world the name of the world for which the string is being formatted; must not be null
052   * @param currency the optional currency to include in the formatted string; can be null
053   * @return a formatted string combining the world and currency information; never null
054   */
055  @NotNull
056  String format(final @NotNull String world, final @Nullable String currency);
057
058  /**
059   * Formats a string representation based on the provided world, optional currency, and quantity.
060   *
061   * @param world the name of the world for which the string is being formatted; must not be null
062   * @param currency the optional currency to include in the formatted string; can be null
063   * @param quantity the quantity to include in the formatted string; represents a non-negative integer
064   * @return a formatted string combining the world, currency, and quantity information; never null
065   */
066  @NotNull
067  String format(final @NotNull String world, final @Nullable String currency, final int quantity);
068
069  /**
070   * Provides a comparator for comparing instances of the generic type U used in the shop's pricing.
071   *
072   * @return a {@link Comparator} for comparing values of type U
073   */
074  Comparator<U> priceComparator();
075
076  /**
077   * Compares the price of the current shop with the price of another shop.
078   *
079   * @param other the other {@code ShopPrice<U>} instance to compare with; must not be null
080   * @param reversed whether the comparison should be reversed (i.e., descending order)
081   * @return a negative integer, zero, or a positive integer as the price of this shop
082   *         is less than, equal to, or greater than the price of the other shop
083   */
084  default int comparePrice(final U other, final boolean reversed) {
085
086    if(reversed) {
087      return priceComparator().reversed().compare(this.price(), other);
088    }
089    return priceComparator().compare(this.price(), other);
090  }
091
092  /**
093   * Retrieves the maximum number of items that can currently be purchased or acquired
094   * based on the shop's available balance and the price of the items.
095   *
096   * @return the maximum number of items that can be afforded; always a non-negative integer.
097   */
098  int getMaxAffordable();
099
100  /**
101   * Determines whether the current shop can afford the transaction of a specified quantity of items.
102   *
103   * @param itemAmount the number of items involved in the transaction; must be a non-negative integer
104   * @return true if the shop can afford the specified number of items, false otherwise
105   */
106  boolean canAfford(final int itemAmount);
107}
